UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing permanent role lock (Client or single-trade Craftsman).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in user.

roleLocked.description: Whether role lock is permanently active.

specialtyId.description: Single locked specialty ID for craftsman accounts.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
